title: File exceeds 1000 lines (1238 lines total)
detail: All main-database ORM model definitions are in a single 1238-line file. As new tables are added, navigation and merge conflicts in model definitions become harder. Consider grouping related models into sub-modules.

title: Unused import at line 26
detail: An import at line 26 is never referenced in the module. Dead imports increase noise in diffs and confusion about what the module depends on. Remove or use it.
